tasks.title: Cognitive Mapping
paras: Cognitive mapping is a term used to describe the mental process by which humans and animals acquire, code, store, recall, and decode information about their spatial environment. This concept, first proposed by psychologist Edward Tolman in the 1940s, revolutionized the understanding of navigation and spatial awareness. Tolman suggested that individuals create internal maps that help them navigate their surroundings efficiently.

Recent research indicates that cognitive mapping is more complex than initially thought. Neuroscientists have discovered that the hippocampus, a region of the brain associated with memory, plays a crucial role in this process. Studies involving brain imaging have shown that when people navigate through unfamiliar environments, the hippocampus becomes highly active. This suggests that cognitive mapping is not just a mental representation but also involves distinct neural pathways.

Moreover, cognitive maps are not static; they evolve with new experiences and information. For instance, if you take a different route to work, your brain updates the existing map to include this new pathway. This dynamic nature of cognitive mapping underscores its importance in learning and adaptation. Despite these advances, many questions remain about the precise mechanisms governing cognitive maps and how they vary across species.

options.A: The process of creating physical maps
options.B: The mental process of understanding spatial environments
options.C: The storage of information in the hippocampus
options.D: The act of navigating familiar environments

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：Cognitive mapping is a term used to describe the mental process by which humans and animals…spatial environment. 解析：认知地图是大脑理解、记忆空间环境的心理过程。 选项分析： A. 制作实体地图，完全不符 B. 理解空间环境的心理过程，完全对应原文，正确 C. 仅指海马体储存信息，定义片面 D. 只局限于熟悉环境导航，范围狭窄

questions.stem: The word “crucial” in the second paragraph is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：词汇题 原文定位：the hippocampus…plays a crucial role in this process. 解析：crucial 意为关键的、重要的。 选项分析： A. significant 重要的，同义替换，正确 B. complex 复杂的，无关 C. optional 可选择的，相反 D. rare 罕见的，不符

questions.stem: What role does the hippocampus play in cognitive mapping?

options.B: It codes memories about familiar routes.
options.C: It decodes information about spatial environments.
options.D: It functions when navigating new environments.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：D 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：when people navigate through unfamiliar environments, the hippocampus becomes highly active. 解析：人在陌生环境导航时，海马体高度活跃，参与认知地图构建。 选项分析： A. 储存纸质地图，无中生有 B. 只记录熟悉路线记忆，原文强调陌生环境，错误 C. 单独解码空间信息，功能夸大 D. 在陌生环境导航时发挥作用，贴合原文，正确

questions.stem: How do cognitive maps change over time?

options.D: They are replaced by complex maps.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：B 题型：细节理解题 原文定位：cognitive maps are not static; they evolve with new experiences and information. 解析：认知地图并非固定不变，会随着新经历不断更新。 选项分析： A. 保持固定不变，与原文相反 B. 跟随新经历更新，正确 C. 细节逐渐减少，文中未提及 D. 被复杂地图取代，无依据

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the third paragraph?

options.A: It explains an additional feature of cognitive mapping.
options.B: It provides evidence contradicting the information presented in the passage.
options.C: It concludes the passage by stating that cognitive mapping is now well studied and understood.
options.D: It describes examples illustrating the numerous features discussed in paragraph 2.

questions.analysis: 正确答案：A 题型：段落目的题 原文定位：Moreover, cognitive maps are not static; they evolve with new experiences… 解析：第三段补充介绍认知地图动态变化、可更新这一额外特征。 选项分析： A. 补充介绍认知地图的另一特征，正确 B. 反驳前文内容，全文逻辑递进，无反驳 C. 表示已完全研究透彻，尾段仍留有未解问题，错误 D. 举例解释第二段多种特点，两段内容不同，错误
